trace.title: Match a filter chain
trace.detail: Without a destination-port sub-tree, the catch-all port is searched by source address; with no match and no default chain, nothing serves the connection.

trace.title: Resolve the route
trace.detail: The route is resolved once, before the first filter, and cached for the stream.

trace.title: Find the virtual host
trace.detail: The host header is lower-cased and looked up among the domains; there are no wildcard domains and no default virtual host here.

trace.title: Set the timeouts and retry policy
trace.detail: The route timeout defaults to 15 s; a per-try timeout at or above it is ignored; num_retries defaults to 1 when a policy is present.

trace.title: Healthy hosts, unless in panic
trace.detail: Below the healthy panic threshold (50%) the load balancer uses every host.

trace.title: Seed the index
trace.detail: The index starts at the load balancer's random seed, so the first host differs between workers and restarts.

trace.title: Queue a pending stream
trace.detail: No connection is ready, so the stream waits for one, under max_pending_requests.

trace.title: Connect
trace.detail: A host with no connections always gets one, even at max_connections.

trace.title: Attach the stream
trace.detail: Attaching a stream to a connection needs a slot under max_requests.

trace.title: Send to the host
trace.detail: The per-try timeout, when set, bounds this attempt; the route timeout, armed when the request completed, bounds every attempt together.

trace.title: Connection failure or reset
trace.detail: A refused connection is a pool failure (remote connection failure) whose transport reason is the connect errno; a reset is a remote reset. Both count as a connect failure, a 503, for outlier detection.

trace.title: Would this be retried?
trace.detail: A status retries under 5xx, gateway-error or a listed retriable status code. An overflow reset never retries; a connection failure retries under connect-failure, and any other reset under reset, 5xx or gateway-error.

trace.title: Retry with back-off
trace.detail: A fully jittered exponential back-off from 25 ms, capped at 250 ms, then a new host pick.
